name: Ohio
note: Permits issued, by the day each was issued, from the Division's Permit and Plug List (Oil & Gas Well Database), the Permit list, which leaves out permits to plug a well. A permit to drill a new well (horizontal or vertical) is a new well, unless its well type is gas storage, a test hole, salt water or solution mining; permits to deepen a well, to reopen one and to plug back and drill again are re-entries; plain plug-backs and conversions are reworks; a re-issued permit, a revised location and a revised unit are amendments (the same well counted again). The Division's own count of permits to drill includes the deepenings and re-issues, so it is higher than the new wells here. The list does not say whether a well is oil or gas (its well type is oil and gas for nearly every well), so the fluid split is not available. The export lists some applications twice; each is counted once. A month is shown once a permit has been issued after it.
